data.body: AC amendment (gap-analysis: race_condition): Add concurrent-writer test — Python writer waits while shell writer holds fcntl.LOCK_EX on $ARTIFACTS_DIR/cycle-ledger.lock. Spawn write-cycle-ledger.sh with FLOCK_STAGE_COMMIT_TIMEOUT override to hold the lock; call cycle_ledger.append_cycle; assert it waits then appends without overwriting shell-writer's entry. Assert lock path is exactly $ARTIFACTS_DIR/cycle-ledger.lock (not a Python-private lock).
